badge.masked.cape_landing: Press [%s] in mid-air while you wear a leather tunic
badge.masked.the_mask: Press [%s] to put your mask on or take it off
badge.masked.warping_shadow: Hold a crossbow in your offhand and fire it
badge.masked.within_the_trees: Hold [%s] while standing on the canopy to sink down through it
message.masked.cape_landing.fumble: Too many eyes on you. Your cape slips through your fingers.
message.masked.warping_shadow.blocked: There is no room for you where the bolt landed.
message.masked.warping_shadow.fumble: Too many eyes on you. Your shadow slips away.
origin.masked.masked.description: Mysterious people of the jungle. They feel most at home with their faces hidden behind a carved mask, and they move through the canopy like a shadow.
origin.masked.masked.name: Masked
power.masked.anthropophobia.description: Without your mask you can't eat, and your wounds won't heal on their own. With other people close by your hands shake, and your cape and your shadow may fail you.
power.masked.anthropophobia.name: Anthropophobia
power.masked.armor_restrictions.descript: Your mask leaves no room for a helmet, and nothing heavier than iron fits you.
power.masked.armor_restrictions.name: Armor Restrictions
power.masked.cape_landing.description: While you wear a leather tunic, you can throw your cape open in mid-air to drift down slowly and land without harm. It needs a few seconds to fold back up afterwards.
power.masked.cape_landing.name: Cape Landing
power.masked.fear_of_the_flames.descript: Fire, lava, lightning, explosions and fireworks hurt you twice as much.
power.masked.fear_of_the_flames.name: Fear of the Flames
power.masked.jungle_companion.descriptio: Your tamed parrots follow you through the canopy and never get stuck or suffocate inside it. While one rides on your shoulder and your mask is on, it keeps watch for you: the haze lifts, you see in the dark, and monsters nearby glow red.
power.masked.jungle_companion.name: Jungle Companion
power.masked.jungle_inhabitant.descripti: You first wake up in a jungle, and you return to one whenever you die without a bed.
power.masked.jungle_inhabitant.name: Jungle Inhabitant
power.masked.the_mask.description: Your mask hides your face. Wear it to slip through the jungle canopy, swift and strong, though you see much less. Take it off to eat and to heal.
power.masked.the_mask.name: The Mask
power.masked.warping_shadow.description: Bolts you fire from a crossbow in your offhand carry your shadow. Wherever the first of them lands, you step out of it.
power.masked.warping_shadow.name: Warping Shadow
power.masked.within_the_trees.descriptio: With your mask on you pass through logs, leaves, vines and bamboo. You run faster, hit harder, jump higher, shrug off knockback and take a fifth less damage, and falls barely hurt you. The mask narrows your sight, though, and a green haze closes in around you.
power.masked.within_the_trees.name: Within the Trees
